dependencies.scope: Selected SAMBU engineering rules are ported into native C behavior; ToolNG does not embed or execute the Python interpreter or .sambu programs.

boundaries: No silent device mutation, network upload, jailbreak, activation-lock bypass, or private iOS API claim.
Backup inspection is read-only and marker-based; it does not verify backup contents or restore ability.
Demo interface previews are not live device evidence.

verification.host_tests: Windows CMake/CTest CI is documented; run the Win32 build and tests.
verification.target_validation: Real Apple-device, driver, pairing, and backup scenarios require separate Windows/device testing.
